messages:
maya (CS): putting together a short go-live primer for at-risk renewals. need a scannable runbook covering cache/batch/stream + a 15min walkthrough. draft below, pls rapid review.

ben (ENG): short & prescriptive is good. suggest 3 action buckets: prefill, warm-run, quick-mitigations. include a tiny runtime snippet.

ben (ENG): ```
# field defaults (small/medium tenants)
cache_enabled: true
cache_prefix_ttl_ms: 20000
batching: {max_batch:12, timeout_ms:10}
streaming: true
```

kai (CS Ops): pre-warm playbook: 1) prefill top-8 prompts at 8 qps for 45s; 2) warm-run: 150 synth sessions at 1.5 qps for 3m; 3) smoke: capture lat_p50, lat_p95, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_req, error_rate. attach traces.

rachel (DE): decision map to top of page: "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> client prefill; tokens_per_req > 350 -> trim context or ask ENG for quantized model; p95 > 900ms -> lower max_batch or enable streaming."

ops-bot: reminder: attach last 5 warm-run traces to tenant ticket and set reminder 24h before call.

maya (CS): 15-min script: 0:00-1:00 intro; 1:00-5:00 demo cold vs warmed; 5:00-9:00 runtime + pre-warm walkthrough; 9:00-13:00 telemetry review; 13:00-15:00 actions + owner. Add checklist: pre-warm done, traces attached, mitigation chosen, eng owner assigned.

ben (ENG): add rollback line: route to fallback-model=quantized-small for up to 24h while investigating.

kai (CS Ops): i'll run the template tomorrow and drop artifacts into ticket. maya will share final PDF after edits.

maya (CS): thanks — will update and post by EOD. :thumbsup:
